title: Coral Reef
description: primetoxinz's CoralReef mod ported to babric b1.7.3 and implemented water breathing feature when on coral (in bubbles).
body: I made this mod as a port of primetoxinz's CoralReef mod to babric b1.7.3 minecraft. I tried to keep most of what was there before (pretty simple mod really) but I implemented water breathing when the player is standing on coral (in the bubbles).
